visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight brown hair and a white t-shirt featuring a small cartoon dog graphic stands in a well-lit studio against a neutral grey wall. She is framed from the chest up, gesturing with her hands as she speaks directly to the camera with a calm facial expression. (2) The screen splits horizontally; the woman continues her explanation in the upper half, while the lower half displays footage of two glasses of iced caffe lattes being served on a counter, followed by a close-up of a bubbling, red-colored spicy hot pot, and finally a white cup of steaming instant noodles. (3) The split-screen format continues; in the bottom half, a different woman is shown sleeping peacefully on her left side in a bright bedroom, resting on a white pillow with white linens. The main speaker in the top half points and gestures to emphasize the sleeping position. (4) The video returns to a full-screen view of the main speaker. She demonstrates the ideal pillow height by stacking her fists vertically in front of her chest. Stylized pink and blue graphics of two stacked fists appear on the right side of the screen to illustrate the '1 to 1.5 fists' height. (5) The speaker concludes her talk, still standing against the grey background. She maintains eye contact with the viewer, her gestures becoming more expansive as she smiles toward the end, and the camera remains static throughout.
